Manhattan Active SCALE Documentation
        Inventory Web Service
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
    
    
    
        The Inventory Web Service allows access to links (URL or URI template) to other web services in the inventory functional area.


     Request



    
        URI: http://ServerName/inventory/inventory

        Method: GET

        Accept: application/json or application/xml

        Roles: SCALEUSER,Confidential
    



     Response



    Aside from standard responses, note the following specifics for this service:

    

    
        
            
                Status Code

                Notes
            

            
                200

                
                    OK will be accompanied by an entity conforming to one of the requested media types: application/vnd.manh.ils.inventory+json, xml

                    Links available:-

                    

                    
                        
                            
                                rel

                                Media type(s)
                            

                            
                                performInventoryTransactions

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.inventoryTransactionRequest+json, XML
                            

                            
                                cancelInventoryTransactions

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.inventoryTransactionRequest+json, XML 
                            

                            
                                getInventoryAttributes

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.inventory.locationInventoryAttributes+json, XML
                            

                            
                                putInventoryAttributes

                                application/vnd.manh.ils.inventory.locationInventoryAttributes+json, XML
